name: Do I need to close my business during a commercial restroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to close my business during a commercial restroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Closing your business for a commercial restroom remodel depends on the project's scope, the number of restrooms available, and the potential for disruption. For projects involving major demolition or plumbing work, a temporary closure of the affected area or the entire business might be necessary. We work to schedule work phases, including after-hours or weekend work, to minimize impact on your operations, especially if you have other restrooms that can remain open.
acceptedAnswer.description: Business closure depends on project scope. We strive to minimize disruption, potentially by phasing work or utilizing off-hours.
